notes.title: Zamarian- Update #7 - Version 2.81
notes.content:
- Added 12 new Steam Achievements:

Terminatus, Bartizan Cruiser, Dragonflyon, Craborian, Renegade Cruiser, Knight Zamari, Mantisian, Fractala, Predatorian, Phoenixian, Streaky Business, and Mean Streak

- Music and sound fx volumes can now be adjusted while the game pause menu

- Prevent  enemy smaller ships from slamming into the player ship in the rear

- Player ships now have navigating weight.  The light fighter moves quicker than the heavy fighter.

- Smaller game buttons

- Smoke special effect on player damage ship

- Use Dpad to navigate menu

notes.title: Zamarian- Update #6 - Version 2.76
notes.content:
This update features the following.

- Added game controller support.  Note: The Steam controller is not supported due to its different format.

Left stick: move the ship around (also use to navigate selections)
Right stick: move ship in/out
Left bumper: access the Ship menu
Right bumper: access the Weapon menu
A button (green): select
Y button (yellow): fire EMP
X button (blue): pause game

- You can play Zamarian with either the mouse or with most popular controllers.  Click the mouse in the game screen to switch to mouse control. 

- Added boss names to boss health bar.

tags.feature: - Added game controller support.
- Added boss names to boss health bar.

notes.title: Zamarian- Update #5 - Version 2.74
notes.content:
This upgrade features the following.

1. Enhances the during game ship and weapon purchases.  The game now paused while the player choose another ship and weapons from the Fighter and Weapon store.  This allows the player to take his/her time to check out the items.

2. Added two more Steam Achievements. 

"Consecutively swipe 30 or 300 mines from the Crab boss and other bosses before crashing into a mine"

3. The hotkey to buy EMP has been changed to 6.

notes.title: Zamarian- Update #3 - Version 2.70
notes.content:
This upgrade includes the following features.

1. Added the Zamarian boss to the game levels.  He will surely taunt you in the fun way.

2. Now you can experience the multiplayer levels by playing solo.  This is where a player can collect some serious amount of gems for coins.

3. The weapons' special effects have been enhanced.


Many thanks for all of your support!

notes.title: Zamarian - Update #2 - Version 2.67
notes.content:
We actually are listening to our reviewers.  Thank you!!!  :)

This upgrade includes four new nice features.

1. Added cockpit simulation grid and aiming target indicator to the hud.  This helps the player locating the enemy location visually.

***Thank you Tartarus Cast and Mellow Gaming

2. Added a nice hud keyboard capability.  During gameplay, the player can now just hit the keyboard keys to instantly buy a new ship or weapon.

You can spot the key appearing right next to the ship and weapon store icons.  The keys are:

H : heavy fighter
M: medium fighter
L: light fighter

E: emp
G: guardian
key 1 to 5 are for the weapons (each fighter has a different set of weapons)

***Thank you for the suggestion, pfmpaulo!!!

3. Add button name to the screen Figher, Weapon, EMP, and Pause buttons.

Also, to help easily identifying the three store Fighter icons, these are now labeled accordingly.  They are Light, Medium, and Heavy fighters.  Notice, the Heavy fighter has the highest shield power.

***Thank you, in' Terrence!

4. The gem pickups now appear larger.  This helps the player not mistakenly picking up look-a-like bullets.  Ouch! :) 

***Thank you, GameStalker!!!
